verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product AI feature that turns a user's Issuing data into insights or suggestions. The closest item, ML-generated fraud and dispute risk scores on each authorization, is a related fraud-scoring feature rather than AI insights or suggestions. The MCP server lets external agents call the Stripe API, which is a developer building block, not an in-product insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
